root_cause.text: Memory leak in btrfs_uring_read_extent() because the 'pages' array and its allocated page structures are not freed on error paths where the function returns before the deferred cleanup by btrfs_uring_read_finished() can occur.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that 'pages' is never freed under the assumption it will be freed by btrfs_uring_read_finished() only on the successful path, but on error paths (allocation failures or non-EIOCBQUEUED returns from btrfs_encoded_read_regular_fill_pages()) the cleanup section frees other allocations but not 'pages'. The patch adds NULL initialization of pages and a loop to free allocated pages and the array in the error cleanup.
